## What changes are proposed?

Describe the concrete code, test, and documentation changes.

## Why are these changes needed?

Explain the user or maintainer problem this PR solves.

## Related issue

Use `Closes #N` for the one open issue addressed by this PR.

## User-facing behavior or migration impact

Describe changes to installed behavior and any migration step. Say `None` when there is no impact.

## Validation

List exact commands and actual results. Mark checks that were skipped and why.

## Compatibility, risk, and rollback

State supported Python/API impact, material risks, and a practical rollback path.

## Documentation and follow-up

Link updated docs and name any scoped follow-up issue.

## Checklist

- [ ] The related issue is linked and this PR is scoped to it.
- [ ] Relevant tests and package checks passed, or skips are explained.
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility impact are accurate.
- [ ] Risks and rollback were reviewed.
- [ ] No secrets, private logs, or customer data are included.
- [ ] Every human-authored commit has a matching DCO sign-off.
